finalText:
Build clean, exit 0. Rest of screenful was noise (deprecation warns, tree-shake notes) — real bugs were two link-stage crashes, both from bundler's options-shape change:

- `src/core/options.js`: read `options.retries`, bundler now sends `retryCount` → fixed to `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js`: strict boolean check threw on `undefined` (new loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`) → now treats `undefined` as `false`.

8 deprecation warnings remain, all pre-existing noise from the bump, not errors.
